title: Rocker from dawn to dusk
lead: Away from the lab, I'm a rock vocalist, songwriter and guitarist with more than a decade of live performance behind me — from the battle-of-the-bands circuit in Mangaluru to festival stages in the UK.
story: I started out fronting Avalanche Brakedown, a six-piece hard rock band from Mangaluru, as lead vocalist and primary songwriter. In its first year the band won ten battle-of-the-bands titles and represented the city at IIT Madras's Saarang, finishing sixth of forty acts nationally.

From 2016 to 2022 I was the lead vocalist and lyricist of Sounds Fishy, a hard rock and ambient metal band. I wrote the lyrics and titles for our originals. "Sympathetic Race" made us the first band from Mangaluru to be played on British radio, our songs reached radio in the UK, New Zealand and the USA, and our debut EP, Retribution — loosely built around the seven deadly sins — was featured by Rolling Stone India.

While studying in the UK, from November 2018 to January 2020, I was the lead vocalist and a backing guitarist for The Southern Bandits, a Brighton-based rock 'n' roll group playing the hits of the '60s, '70s and '80s, taking the stage at Corefest, Shoreham Music Festival and Worthing Music Festival in 2019.

Today my main project is The Speksy Pscyentist (TSP), a duo with fellow researcher Jyoshma D'Souza, where science meets symphony. Our 2024 single "Rain It Down on Me", which I sang and wrote the lyrics for, was featured on VEVO, likely a first for a Mangalurean act.
